name: rocket-chip
description: Rocket Chip is a parameterized RISC-V SoC generator featuring RV64GC in-order cores, L1/L2 caches, and TileLink interconnect, implemented in Chisel.

interfaces.description: Main-memory AXI4 master (idBits=4, base 0x80000000) to external DRAM.
MMIO AXI4 master (base 0x60000000) to the peripheral fabric.
Slave AXI4 port for external DMA into the cache hierarchy.
External interrupt inputs (WithNExtTopInterrupts(2)) into the on-chip PLIC.

parameters.name: XLEN
parameters.description: Width of the RISC-V processor's general-purpose registers.

parameters.name: L1_CACHE_SIZE
parameters.description: Size of the L1 cache in kilobytes.

parameters.name: L2_CACHE_SIZE
parameters.description: Size of the L2 cache in kilobytes.

parameters.name: NUM_CORES
parameters.description: Number of RISC-V cores in the SoC.

dependencies.name: Chisel
dependencies.description: Hardware construction language used to generate the Rocket Chip.

dependencies.name: TileLink
dependencies.description: Coherent interconnect protocol used for communication between cores and peripherals.

dependencies.name: opentitan-tlul
dependencies.description: tlul_pkg + tlul_adapter_host — TL-UL infra used by the rocket_tile_tlul host wrapper.

dependencies.name: vyges/tlul-axi-bridge
dependencies.description: tlul_axi_lite_bridge — AXI4-Lite slave to TL-UL host (mmio path). (PRIVATE Vyges IP — sources: vyges)

dependencies.name: verilog-axi
dependencies.description: axi_axil_adapter — AXI4 to AXI4-Lite (64->32) for Rocket mmio_axi4 in rocket_tile_tlul.
